premise: Geologist's ice gets smaller every day and nobody has touched it; Drone keeps watch, and the photos crack the case: in the sunlight, the ice turns straight into vapour.
inspiration: The detective puzzle of Poe's 'The Purloined Letter' (the answer hidden in plain sight), turned: the thief is the Sun.
lesson: Look carefully before you blame anyone.
learning: In sunlight, moon ice turns straight into vapour without melting.

en-US.title: The Vanishing Ice
en-US.text: {geologist:enter} {geologist:face happy} Geologist had found a beautiful chunk of {ice:enter} ice. But every day, it got a little smaller. {geologist:face surprised} Nobody had touched it. Nobody had chipped it. So where was it going? [curious] A mystery! {drone:float loop 0.3} {geologist:go to ice} Geologist set {drone:enter} Drone to keep watch, {drone:live hold} its lens focused on the ice all day long. Nobody came. Nobody at all. {drone:live resume} Flash! Geologist looked at the photos. {geologist:live} He peered through his glasses… {ice:live hold} there! Thin wisps of frost, curling up off the ice in the sunlight. {geologist:face happy} [excited] The thief is the Sun! In sunlight, moon ice turns straight into vapour, without melting at all. So he built the ice a little shade out of moon-brick. {geologist:hearts} Case closed. {drone:pulse} [whispers] The thief is still up there, shining.

es-ES.title: El hielo que desaparecía
es-ES.text: {geologist:enter} {geologist:face happy} Geólogo había encontrado un trozo precioso de {ice:enter} hielo. Pero cada día era un poquito más pequeño. {geologist:face surprised} Nadie lo había tocado. Nadie le había arrancado un trozo. ¿Adónde se iba, entonces? [curious] ¡Un misterio! {drone:float loop 0.3} {geologist:go to ice} Geólogo puso a {drone:enter} Dron de vigilante, {drone:live hold} con el objetivo enfocado en el hielo todo el día. No vino nadie. Nadie de nadie. {drone:live resume} ¡Flash! Geólogo miró las fotos. {geologist:live} Las estudió con sus gafas… {ice:live hold} ¡ahí! Hilillos de escarcha que subían del hielo, al sol. {geologist:face happy} [excited] ¡El ladrón es el Sol! Con la luz del sol, el hielo lunar se convierte directamente en vapor, sin derretirse. Así que le construyó al hielo una sombrilla de ladrillo lunar. {geologist:hearts} Caso cerrado. {drone:pulse} [whispers] El ladrón sigue ahí arriba, brillando.
